episodes.title: My So-Called Death
episodes.summary: While acclimating to purgatory at Split River High, Maddie becomes determined to solve the mystery of her disappearance. While observing those she left behind, Maddie begins to realize everyone is not as honest and loyal as she once thought.

episodes.title: The Fault in Our Scars
episodes.summary: As she grows close to the spirits in the ghost world, a driven Maddie begins to unravel the events surrounding her death, only to discover someone other than Xavier may have been involved.

episodes.title: Dead and Confused
episodes.summary: With an unexpected suspect possibly involved in her death, Maddie's forced to reveal more about the depth of that relationship - leading to unexpected consequences.

episodes.title: Ghoul Intentions
episodes.summary: When the search for Maddie's killer puts Simon in real jeopardy and exposes Maddie's connection to the living world, Maddie must navigate Split River High's spooky spectral underbelly - first alone, and then with the help of her fellow ghosts.

episodes.title: The Twilight End Zone
episodes.summary: As Homecoming unfolds at Split River, Maddie finds herself divided between accepting her fate in purgatory and a newly hatched plan to crack a new suspect.

episodes.title: Grave the Last Dance
episodes.summary: Amongst the sparkly lights of Split River's Homecoming Dance, Operation Find Maddie's Killer goes into overdrive leading to surprising revelations.

episodes.title: Séance Anything
episodes.summary: Hoping to recount her last living moments, Maddie and her fellow spirits hold an anti-séance which brings to light a shocking new theory.

episodes.title: Madison's Body
episodes.summary: In a thrilling finale, Maddie finally pieces together the puzzle of her disappearance which has severe consequences in both the spirit and living worlds.

episodes.title: Whatever Happened to Maddie Nears?
episodes.summary: Maddie confronts Mr. Martin, who flees. Janet, in Maddie's body, returns to her family's now dilapidated farmhouse, triggering memories. A conflicted Simon struggles with his desire to help Maddie and protect his own grasp on reality.

episodes.title: Field of Screams
episodes.summary: Fugitive Janet is haunted by her past as the ghost group continues searching for Mr. Martin inside Split River High. Simon tells the living kids about Janet's body-snatching. A fire at a dilapidated farmhouse leaves Maddie's fate unclear.

episodes.title: Can't Hauntly Wait
episodes.summary: A relentless Sandra is desperate to know her daughters fate, as Janet in Maddie's body wreaks havoc in the living world. Simon and friends search for Janet/Maddie in an unlikely place, as the ghosts decode Janet's past.

episodes.title: A Walk-In to Remember
episodes.summary: Janet/Maddie returns home to a shocked and relieved Sandra. The ghosts discover the objects from their deaths unlock hidden spaces. A mandatory school event uncovers tension between the living kids who are more concerned about Janet's return.

episodes.title: Ghost Who's Coming to Dinner
episodes.summary: Janet/Maddie agrees to have Maddie's friends over for dinner and the tense meal ends with Janet realizing her cover is blown. Meanwhile, Maddie explores the school's "scars" and uncovers intel about Janet that shakes her resolve.

episodes.title: Ghost Pointe Blank
episodes.summary: Maddie and the ghosts find a link between theirs scars while Simon and team go on a mission where tensions rise with the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Anatomy of a Fallout Shelter
episodes.summary: Janet is finally ready to give answers. Mr. Martin hatches a plan, Maddie reevaluates her relationships with Wally and Simon, and Quinn makes a discovery.

episodes.title: Fire, Talk to Me
episodes.summary: The support group faces their pasts. When Maddie's body is put in jeopardy, both the ghosts and the living are put to the test.

episodes.title: It's a Wonderful Afterlife
episodes.summary: Maddie's return upends Split River High. As she adjusts, not everyone welcomes her back. Simon is trapped on the other side while the ghosts search for answers and dark new secrets about the school emerge.

episodes.title: Mean Ghouls
episodes.summary: Split River High grows volatile as Maddie faces mounting pressure. Buried truths and new dangers are revealed that could change everything for the living and dead, forcing some to question who they can really trust.

episodes.title: The Halls Have Eyes
episodes.summary: New mysteries at Split River High force Maddie, Simon and the ghosts to choose between leaving the past alone or exploring it and triggering unseen dangers. Nicole joins a new circle, and Simon and Wally take a risky leap for answers.

episodes.title: The Bereftest Club
episodes.summary: A day of detention sparks a journey into the school's secret past. Hidden truths resurface, dark forces stir, and Quinn undergoes a powerful transformation. Maddie and her friends uncover clues connecting the living and the dead.

episodes.title: Raiders of the Lost Scar
episodes.summary: Darkness spreads through Split River High as Maddie's visions intensify and new truths emerge. Each discovery deepens the danger, leaving Simon's fate hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Children of the Scorned
episodes.summary: Maddie faces a powerful new threat as Simon slips further into danger.

episodes.title: Midsomester
episodes.summary: After a shocking event, Maddie and Xavier come under suspicion. As the living investigate a corrupt scheme, the ghosts search their scars for clues, Maddie opens up, and someone takes a big leap that could change everything.

episodes.title: Dawn of the Deb
episodes.summary: The team confronts a dangerous force in a desperate bid to save their friends.
